column1: PART I : SECTION (I)  — GENERAL
Government  Notifications
Forest Conservation Ordinance
The order under section 3. that has to be read with Section 64. (1) of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451),
as No. 13 of 1966, as amended by Acts, No. 56 of 1979, No 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of
2009 that have to be read with Section 51 of the 19th amendment of the Constitution of Democratic Socialist Republic of
Sri Lanka.
The Order
By  virtue  of powers  vested  in  me  by  section 3. of the Forest  Conservation  Ordinance  (Chapter  451)  as  amended by
Acts, No. 13 of 1966, No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of  2009, that have to
be  read  with  Section  51  of  the  19th amendment  of  the  Constitution  of    Democratic  Socialist  Republic  of  Sri  Lanka,
I Maithripala Sirisena, President  do by this order declare the Sinharaja Forest of 36474.93 hectares bounded by the limit
set forth in the schedule 1 and 2 hereto as Sinharaja Reserved Forest from 11th day of November, 2019.
Gazette Extra ordinary  No.5118 of  May 12, 1893 declaring Panila  Forest Gazette Extra ordinary  No.4988 of April
03, 1896 declaring Walankanda Forest Gazette Extra ordinary Notice No.5203 of February 10, 1893 declaring Madampe
Forest  Gazette  Extra  ordinary    No.4569  of    December  13,  1889  declaring  Nahitiya  Forest    Gazette  Extra  ordinary
No.4046  of  May  08,  1875  declaring  Sinharaja  Forest  Gazette  Extra  ordinary  No.7526  of  May  21,  1926  declaring
Sinharaja Forest are hereby repealed.
MAITHRIPALA SIRISENA,
President.
11th day of November, 2019
Colombo
